To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the design of a ball and plate system for learning control systems is a low cost and simple project, that can be used as a tool to implement and assess different control strategies.

(a) a simple and low-cost ball and plate plant can be used as an undergraduate engineering project to teach control systems theory, and (b) students may be assisted to learn control systems by designing and implementing their own ball and plate plant, and by applying mathematical and computational tools, control systems theory and software-hardware implementation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a ball and plate system, the implementation of a position control strategy, and the development of the control system.
the development of a low-cost, open-source, ball and plate platform that can be used as a teaching tool to help undergraduate students in the control engineering courses.
the design and implementation, in a low-cost platform, of a ball and plate control system, and the use of this system in the teaching of control engineering.
